items.title: A product of quasi-compact topological spaces is quasi-compact
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is Tychonov's theorem in the form that a product of quasi-compact spaces is quasi-compact (author theorem at source lines 2662-2665, label theorem-tychonov); the author's own proof at source lines 2667-2684 follows it immediately and is its proof. The proof applies the subbasis theorem to the standard subbasis of the product, groups a covering by the factor it comes from and argues that either one factor is covered, giving a finite subcover, or a point of the product lies outside the covering (proof lines 2667-2683). The dichotomy on the factors is the content. H3.
